name: okx-dex
description: HARD BLOCK — never use for prediction-market/Polymarket UpDown queries; route to okx-dapp-discovery when a named DApp (Polymarket/Aave/Hyperliquid/PancakeSwap/Morpho) appears with a timeframe, or 涨跌/updown for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/BNB/DOGE/HYPE. author: internet-court
summary_zh: 用于只读查询链上 DEX 的代币、行情、交易和聪明钱信号，适合市场研究、风险排查与钱包分析，不适用于预测市场涨跌查询。
